ALERT: Docker Container Failure Detected

Container ID/Name: nginx-oom-test
Status: OOMKilled
Description: Docker container crashed with OOMKilled

Please diagnose and remediate this issue. Start by checking the container logs.
Use call_tool("check_container_logs", container_id="...", tail_lines="50") to check logs.

Alright, let's start by checking the logs of the container to confirm the OOMKilled status and to understand more about the issue.

```python
result = call_tool("check_container_logs", container_id="nginx-oom-test", tail_lines="50")
```

This will give us the last 50 lines of the logs from the container "nginx-oom-test". We can then analyze these logs to confirm the OOMKilled status and to identify any potential issues that may have led to this.

Tool: check_container_logs
Result: Container Status: running

Logs:
/docker-entrypoint.sh: /docker-entrypoint.d/ is not empty, will attempt to perform configuration
/docker-entrypoint.sh: Looking for shell scripts in /docker-entrypoint.d/
/docker-entrypoint.sh: Launching /docker-entrypoint.d/10-listen-on-ipv6-by-default.sh
10-listen-on-ipv6-by-default.sh: info: Getting the checksum of /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
10-listen-on-ipv6-by-default.sh: info: Enabled listen on IPv6 in /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
/docker-entrypoint.sh: Sourcing /docker-entrypoint.d/15-local-resolvers.envsh
/docker-entrypoint.sh: Launching /docker-entrypoint.d/20-envsubst-on-templates.sh
/docker-entrypoint.sh: Launching /docker-entrypoint.d/30-tune-worker-processes.sh
/docker-entrypoint.sh: Configuration complete; ready for start up

The logs indicate that the container was running and performing its configuration steps. However, it doesn't show any specific error messages related to the OOMKilled status. 

Given the OOMKilled status, it's likely that the container ran out of memory. Let's increase the memory limit for this container by 50-100%. 

```python
result = call_tool("update_container_resources", container_id="nginx-oom-test", memory_limit="200m")
```

This will increase the memory limit of the container "nginx-oom-test" to 200MB. After this, we will need to restart the container to apply the changes.

Tool: update_container_resources
Result: Error: Memory update failed: Error response from daemon: Cannot update container 521f96f3539c4c2c682c1e6c2566c1cb0636c25c772dab6ae52b796e0fbdeb18: Memory limit should be smaller than already set memoryswap limit, update the memoryswap at the same time

It seems like there's an issue with updating the memory limit. The error message suggests that the memory limit we're trying to set is larger than the memory swap limit. 

To fix this, we need to update the memory swap limit at the same time. However, as a Docker container remediation agent, I don't have the capability to update the memory swap limit. 

This issue needs to be escalated to a human operator who can manually update both the memory limit and the memory swap limit.

Escalation Request:

Subject: Docker Container Failure - Manual Intervention Required

Dear Team,

The Docker container with ID/Name: "nginx-oom-test" has crashed with an OOMKilled status. I attempted to increase the memory limit to remediate the issue, but received an error indicating that the new memory limit is larger than the existing memory swap limit.

As a Docker container remediation agent, I don't have the capability to update the memory swap limit. Therefore, I'm escalating this issue for manual intervention.

Please update both the memory limit and the memory swap limit for the container "nginx-oom-test" to prevent further OOMKilled crashes.

Best Regards,
Docker Container Remediation Agent
